facts.fact: India Post's savings page gives the Post Office Monthly Income Scheme rate as 7.4% per annum, payable monthly
facts.quote: Post Office Monthly Income Scheme Account (MIS) Rate of Interest: 7.4% per annum payable monthly
facts.note: The India Post page shows 'Last Updated On: 19.10.2026' (within Q3 FY 2026-27).

facts.fact: The NSI table shows MIS at 7.4% from 1.4.2023 to 30.09.2026 (covering Jul-Sep 2026)
6.6% was the MIS rate from April 2020 to September 2022, not the current rate
Rates for 1 Oct - 31 Dec 2026 (Q3 FY 2026-27) were set by DEA's Office Memorandum dated 30.09.2026
facts.quote: Revision of interest rates for Small Savings Schemes for Q3 2026-27 30.09.2026

facts.fact: The 30.09.2026 OM kept all small savings rates for Oct-Dec 2026 (Q3 FY 2026-27) unchanged from Q2, so MIS stays at 7.4%
facts.quote: The rates of interest on various Small Savings Schemes for the third quarter of FY 2026-27 starting from 1% October, 2026 and ending on 31° December, 2026 shall remain unchanged from those notified for the second quarter
facts.note: DEA OM F.No.1/4/2019-NS dated 30.09.2026, read by OCR of the scanned PDF. The 7.4% MIS rate is derived: the OM gives no rates; it keeps Q2 rates, and NSI shows this rate to 30.09.2026 and India Post shows it now.

summary: MIS 7.4% confirmed (India Post current page; NSI to 30.09.2026), 6.6% confirmed as the 2020-22 rate; DEA Q3 OM dated 30.09.2026 confirmed; 'unchanged' only in the scanned OM (manual).
